aboutGame.title: What is BSS Reworked?
paragraphs: BSS Reworked is an immersive bee simulator experience on Roblox reimagining classic swarm mechanics with modernized progression, vibrant fields, and dynamic honey collection. Hatch diverse bee species, assemble your custom hive, and harvest pollen across expansive floral fields.

Whether you are completing bear quests, crafting powerful collector equipment, or optimizing your bee team with synergistic boosts, our community wiki provides accurate guides, active codes, and up-to-date data tables to accelerate your journey.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about BSS Reworked.

items.question: What is BSS Reworked?
items.answer: BSS Reworked is an enhanced Roblox bee simulator experience where players collect pollen, hatch diverse bee species, build customized hives, and convert pollen into honey. The game features expanded fields, modernized quest lines, and deep progression mechanics.

items.question: How do I redeem codes in BSS Reworked?
items.answer: To redeem codes in BSS Reworked, open the settings or promo menu in-game, enter any working code from our active codes list, and click Redeem to receive instant honey, royal jellies, and field boosts.

items.question: What is the fastest way to earn honey in BSS Reworked?
items.answer: The fastest way to earn honey in BSS Reworked is to align your bee types with high-tier floral fields, collect active boost tokens, complete Bear quests regularly, and upgrade your backpack capacity to maximize each harvest run.

items.question: Which bees should beginners prioritize in BSS Reworked?
items.answer: Beginners in BSS Reworked should focus on hatching a balanced swarm of Rare and Epic bees that produce Haste and Focus tokens, enabling faster movement across fields and higher pollen gathering rates.

items.question: How does rebirth progression work in BSS Reworked?
items.answer: Rebirth progression in BSS Reworked allows experienced beekeepers to reset certain milestones in exchange for permanent honey multipliers, exclusive equipment access, and elite hive upgrades.
